{{Quote|Oh, why am I wasting my vocoder on ''you?'' You're only a ''fifth degree droid&mdash;''<nowiki></nowiki>''"<br />"''Hey! What's ''that'' supposed to mean? ''I'm'' a fifth-degree!|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] demeans a fifth-degree [[Droid/Legends|droid]], which inadvertently offends [[Unidentified fifth-degree droid|another droid]]|<ref name="Droids 3">[[Droids (1995) 3|''Droids'' (1995) 3]]</ref>}}
A '''class five droid''' or '''fifth-degree droid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] programmed for menial and low-skill tasks. Such droids tended to perform basic tasks such as lifting, maintenance, [[Mining/Legends|mining]], sanitation, and transportation. [[Labor droid/Legends|Labor droids]] were fifth-degree droids.
